Interface SysMLStateMachine.TransitionsUtility

All Known Implementing Classes:
StateTransitionsTransmitters
Enclosing class:
SysMLStateMachine
public static interface SysMLStateMachine.TransitionsUtility
Interface for an optional implementation of a utility for accessing the state transitions information (current state, event, guard, effect, next state, etc.) that are available during state machine execution. The interface's operations are invoked by the SysMLStateMachine during performance of state transistions, i.e. during the performInitialTransition() and performTransition() operations. The implementation of the TransitionsUtiliy should be created in an override of the createTransitionsUtility() operation by initializing the transitionsUtility variable, e.g. 

transitionsUtility = new MyTransitionsUtility(int arg);
where the constructor is for a class that implements the TransitionsUtility interface. The referenced class below from the SysMLinJava tools package is an example implementation of this interface for transmitting state transition table and timing diagram information to display applications.

ModelerOne

      void perform(Optional<? extends StateBehaviorContext> context, SysMLStateMachine stateMachine, SysMLVertex currentState, Optional<SysMLEvent> currentEvent, SysMLTransition transition, Optional<SysMLGuard> guard, Optional<SysMLEffect> effect, SysMLVertex nextState, Logger logger)
      Specifies the method call to transmit to a state transitions table display the specified state transition information. The transition information is converted to appropriate text for state table rows and transmitted to the display.
      Parameters:
      context - state machine's context part
      stateMachine - state machine
      currentState - current state of state machine
      currentEvent - current event responding to by state machine
      transition - current transition of state machine
      guard - current guard of current transition
      effect - current effect of current transition
      nextState - next state after transition
      logger - logger to be used for logging
